title: Salt Flats at Dusk
logline: A retired surveyor walks the dry lakebed where her late husband charted the horizon, and finds his last survey stakes still standing in a perfect line.

title: Night Shift Karaoke
logline: Three hospital cleaners hold a secret karaoke contest in the empty cafeteria every night at 3 a.m., until a new security guard walks in on the final round.

title: The Lighthouse Does Not Answer
logline: A supply boat crew lands on a rock where the light has gone dark, and each of them hears the keeper's voice from a different room.
